logo.note: No logo: the crown and the GOV.UK logotype are protected, and the GOV.UK Service Manual says a service that is not on GOV.UK must not use them (or the GDS Transport typeface, or suggest it is an official government site). Polyxd sets the words GOV.UK Design System in its own type instead.

provenance.notes: GOV.UK publishes no token file; its Sass settings are vendored verbatim under scripts/sources/govuk and the generator reads their maps.
